THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Open-Faced Ham, Egg & Cheese Stacks

Three open-faced stacks on Sola toast — a thin folded egg, fat-free cheddar and Black Forest ham. About 145 calories and 17g protein per stack.

YIELD3 servings
TOTAL TIME10 min
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~145 cal | ~17g protein

Ingredients

Ingredients

  • 3 slices Sola Sweet & Buttery Soft White Bread (26g each)
  • 3 large Happy Egg Heritage free-range eggs
  • ¼ cup (28g) Great Value fat-free shredded mild cheddar, divided into thirds
  • 3 slices 365 Organic Black Forest uncured ham (about 56g total)
  • Cooking spray

Allergens: wheat, gluten, eggs, dairy.

You want a light, protein-forward breakfast on a rest day. Each open-faced stack is about 145 calories and 17g protein; three are about 435 calories and 50g protein.

Method

  1. 1.TOAST. Toast the 3 slices of Sola bread.
  2. 2.POUR THIN. Beat 1 egg. Mist a nonstick pan with cooking spray and pour the egg in a thin round. The filmed build used induction level 7.
  3. 3.CHEESE. When the egg has set, sprinkle a third of the cheddar over it.
  4. 4.FOLD. Fold the egg in half like a crepe.
  5. 5.ONTO TOAST. Slide the folded egg onto a slice of toast.
  6. 6.HAM ON TOP. Lay 1 slice of Black Forest ham over the egg.
  7. 7.REPEAT. Make two more stacks the same way and serve open-faced.

Estimated nutrition

~145 cal | ~17g protein per 1 open-faced stack.

Numbers describe the filmed build: 3 slices Sola Sweet & Buttery, 3 Happy Egg Heritage large eggs, 3 slices 365 Organic Black Forest ham and 1/4 cup Great Value fat-free cheddar across 3 stacks, cooking spray not counted. Per stack about 145 calories, 17g protein, 10g carbs (9g fiber, 1g net) and 7g fat; all 3 stacks about 435 calories and 50g protein. Estimates come from package labels, not lab tests. Net carbs use Sola's current 0g-net label; older bags list 1g net per slice. Swap in full-fat cheddar and each stack gains ~20 cal and ~3g fat (≈65 cal and ~9g fat across the batch).
